name: Entity Tasks
description: Exposes a block that displays the available local tasks (tabs) for the current page, plus optional admin-toolbar integration.
project_description: Entity Tasks exposes a block that displays the local tasks (the View / Edit / Delete / Revisions / Translate tabs) available for the current page, so the current route's operation tabs can be placed anywhere in the layout instead of only in the default local-tasks region. It also provides an admin-toolbar integration with three display modes (classic, expanded, dropdown) selectable at /admin/config/entity-tasks, and per-block placement of the tabs on the left- or right-hand side of the screen. The tabs shown are Drupal core's own local tasks for the matched route, filtered to those the current user may access; the module adds display and placement only, not new operations or access.
